name: Yuuki Chizuru
source:
The director of “Matsunomi En” where the main characters work, and the mother of Miya & Shinya.

She adores children and considers the main characters as her child.

She has a somewhat carefree and optimistic personality, and depending on how you look at her, she can be seen as an airhead.

She is a motherly woman who smiles and gives out gentle hugs.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=27901]getchu[/url]]
